sl: Pregled strani ne zapisuje več strani v predpomnilnik celotnih strani, zato ta ne raste več vsako noč in ne polni diska.
en: The page review no longer writes pages into the full page cache, so the cache stops growing every night and filling the disk.

sl: Opombe ob izdaji za stran modula.
en: Release notes for the module page.

sl: Pregled strani: nastavitev prijave HTTP za trgovino za geslom (šifrirano), da testna trgovina za osnovno prijavo ni več v celoti označena kot napaka 401. Podatki gredo samo na strežnike trgovine.
Pregled strani prebere podatke o izdelku tudi iz mikropodatkov na strani, zato cena, razpoložljivost ali ocena niso več napačno označene kot manjkajoče.
Tedenska e-pošta pri strani, ki ne obstaja, pokaže, koliko obiskov so bili roboti in AI pomočniki.
Popravek: robots.txt je v trgovini, ki ni nikoli shranila lastnih pravil, vračal napako 500.
en: Page review: an HTTP login setting for a shop behind a password (encrypted), so a staging shop behind basic authentication is no longer reported as HTTP 401 on every page. Credentials go only to the shop's own hosts.
The page review reads product facts from the page's microdata too, so a price, availability or rating is no longer wrongly reported as missing.
The weekly e-mail shows, for a page that does not exist, how many visits came from bots and AI assistants.
Fix: robots.txt answered an error 500 on a shop that had never saved its own rules.

sl: Pregled strani: če izdelki v strukturiranih podatkih nimajo cene, pa je modul Rich Snippets nameščen z izklopljenim zapisom izdelkov, nasvet to pove in vodi do nastavitve.
en: Page review: when products have no price in the structured data and Rich Snippets is installed with its product data switched off, the advice says so and links to the setting.

sl: Pregled strani, SEO in GEO na enem mestu: vsako noč trgovina prebere vse strani kot iskalnik (domača stran, izdelke, kategorije, strani CMS) in našteje 20 vrst težav z nasvetom in povezavo Popravi.
Težave med stranmi: podvojeni naslovi in opisi ter povezave na strani, ki ne obstajajo ali preusmerjajo.
Ocena za vsako stran in za trgovino, trend zadnjih pregledov in ročni Pregled zdaj.
Dnevnik napak 404 z enim klikom za preusmeritev na najbolj podobno stran.
Tedenska e-pošta ob ponedeljkih z oceno po pogledih trgovine in največjimi težavami, v jeziku trgovine.
Če CDN zavrne zahteve strežnika, pregled bere strežnik neposredno.
en: Page review, SEO and GEO in one place: every night the shop reads all its pages like a search engine (home, products, categories, CMS pages) and lists 20 kinds of problems with advice and a Fix link.
Problems across pages: repeated titles and descriptions, and links to pages that do not exist or redirect.
A score per page and for the shop, a trend of the last reviews and a manual Review now.
A 404 log with one click to redirect to the most similar page.
A Monday weekly e-mail with the score per store view and the biggest problems, in the shop's language.
When a CDN refuses the server's own requests, the review reads the web server directly.

sl: Menijski vnos se imenuje Vidnost za AI, Nastavitve so zadnje.
en: The menu entry is called AI Visibility and Settings comes last.

sl: Vir izdelkov ACP je popolnejši: čisto besedilo opisa, črtne kode GTIN, kategorije, možnosti različic, prodajalec in nadomestno besedilo slik.
Pravilen naslov /ucp, kjer strežnik zavrne poti /.well-known/, in ukaz za takojšnjo ponovno gradnjo vira.
en: A fuller ACP product feed: a plain-text description, GTIN barcodes, categories, variant options, seller and image alt text.
A /ucp address for servers that refuse /.well-known/ paths, and a command to rebuild the feed at once.

sl: Prva različica: vidnost v odgovorih AI. Datoteki llms.txt in llms-full.txt po pogledu trgovine.
Pravila za AI pajke v robots.txt (26 pajkov), dnevnik obiskov pajkov, tudi iz predpomnilnika strani.
Obiski, naročila in prihodek iz enajstih AI pomočnikov, tudi za naročila prek REST.
Pregled, revizija strani kot AI pajek in poročilo o pripravljenosti kataloga.
Agentna prodaja: vir izdelkov ACP (OpenAI) po pogledu trgovine, osvežen na tri ure, in blagajna UCP (Google), ki nakup konča v vaši blagajni.
Povezava do košarice za pomočnike, ki lahko pokažejo samo povezavo, z omejitvijo zahtev in dnevno zgornjo mejo.
en: First version: visibility in AI answers. llms.txt and llms-full.txt per store view.
AI crawler rules in robots.txt (26 crawlers) and a crawler visit log, also from the page cache.
Visits, orders and revenue from eleven AI assistants, including orders placed over REST.
An overview, a page audit as an AI crawler and a catalog readiness report.
Agentic commerce: an ACP product feed (OpenAI) per store view, refreshed every three hours, and a UCP checkout (Google) that ends the purchase in your own checkout.
A cart link for assistants that can only show a link, with a rate limit and a daily ceiling.
